name: Kleiner Perkins
history: Kleiner Perkins was founded in 1972 in Menlo Park by Eugene Kleiner and Tom Perkins. The bets that made it were Genentech, Compaq, Sun Microsystems, Netscape, Amazon and Google, followed later by Twitter, Spotify, Slack, DoorDash and Figma. In 2026 it raised $3.5 billion: a $1 billion early-stage fund, its twenty-second, and $2.5 billion for growth investments.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins XXII, LLC

sources.note: Firm post 2026-03-24: 'KP22, a $1 billion fund to back early-stage companies'. The Form D (first sale 2026-03-23) and the ADV both carry $995,000,000, which is the size published; the firm rounds to $1 billion.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Select Fund IV, LLC

sources.note: Firm post 2026-03-24: '$2.5 billion in growth funds'; Select Fund IV is $1.92B of it (Form D, first sale 2026-03-23), Flex I the rest.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Flex I, LLC

sources.note: The second of the 2026 growth funds: the post's address ends 'select-iv-flex', its text does not name Flex. Form D, first sale 2026-03-23; the ADV carries $550,000,000. Select Fund IV and Flex I together are $2.475B, the firm's '$2.5 billion'.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins XXI, LLC

sources.note: Firm post 2024-06-28: 'KP21, an $825M fund to back early stage companies'. Form D, first sale 2024-06-28.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Select Fund III, LLC

sources.note: Firm post 2024-06-28: 'KP Select III, a $1.2 billion fund to back high inflection investments'. The Form D carries XXI's filer prefix; the issuer is Select Fund III (CIK 2027882).

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins XX, LLC

sources.note: Firm post 2022-01-11: 'KP 20, an $800m fund to back early stage companies'. Form D 0001894867-22-000001: $800M offered, $0 sold (filed before the close), so the size is the firm's and no accession is asserted.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Select Fund II, LLC

sources.note: Firm post 2022-01-11: 'KP Select II, a $1 billion fund'. Form D 0001894699-22-000001: $1B offered, $0 sold.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Select Fund, LLC

sources.note: Firm post 2021-04-19: 'Kleiner Perkins Select, a new $750M fund' (Select I). Form D 0001853994-21-000001: $750M offered, $0 sold.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XIX, LLC

sources.note: Firm post 2020-03-05: 'KP19, with $700M to focus on early-stage investments'. Form D 0001801167-20-000001: $700M offered, $0 sold.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XVIII, LLC

sources.note: Crunchbase News 2019-01-31: the firm 'had raised $600 million in new capital for its 18th venture fund'; the firm's KP19 post: 'When we announced KP18 in January of last year'. Form D 0001764543-19-000001: $600M offered, $0 sold.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XVII, LLC

sources.note: Crunchbase News 2019-01-31: Fund XVII (2016) was $400 million. Form D 0001678018-16-000001: $400M offered, $0 sold.

funds.name: KPCB Digital Growth Fund III, LLC

sources.note: Crunchbase News 2019-01-31: '$1 billion for its third Digital Growth Fund', raised beside XVII in 2016. Form D 0001678000-16-000001: $1B offered, $0 sold. Managed by the growth team that left to form Bond in September 2018; the vehicle stayed a Kleiner Perkins fund (decisions.md D2).

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XVI, LLC

sources.note: Reuters 2014-06-28: filed for 'an early-stage growth fund of $450 million'; Fortune 2014-04-14 gave the same target. Form D 0001611731-14-000001: $450M offered, $0 sold. The size is the offering; no close announcement was found.

funds.name: KPCB Digital Growth Fund II, LLC

sources.note: Reuters 2014-06-28: 'a later-stage fund of $750 million'; Fortune 2014-04-14: '$750 million for its second digital growth fund'. Form D 0001611731-14-000002 (XVI's filer prefix, issuer CIK 1611736): $750M offered, $0 sold. The size is the offering.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XV, LLC

sources.note: TechCrunch 2012-05-17: 'closed on a $525 million round for its fifteenth venture fund, dubbed KPCB 15'. Form D 0001547840-12-000001: $525M offered, $0 sold.

funds.name: KPCB China Fund II, L.P.

sources.note: VentureBeat 2011-11-03: 'Kleiner Perkins has raised a $250 million fund to invest in Chinese companies, according to a filing'. Form D 0001533831-11-000001: $250M offered, $0 sold; no close announcement was found, so the size is the offering. On Kleiner Perkins' own 7.B.(1). Listed under the provisional reading of decisions.md X1.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XIV, LLC

sources.note: Fortune 2010-10-27: KPCB XIV 'is targeting $650 million'; Fortune 2011-02-16: 'sources say that the final figure will be slightly higher'. Form D 0001505781-10-000001: $650M offered, $0 sold. The final close was not published, so the size is the offering.

funds.name: KPCB Digital Growth Fund, LLC

sources.note: Fortune 2011-02-16: 'KP recently increased the Digital Growth Fund's size to more than $1 billion' (the first target was $750M); TechCrunch 2012-05-17: 'In late 2010 the firm raised $1 billion for its digital growth fund'. The amended Form D 0001505782-11-000001 shows $932,326,251 sold of $1,000,000,000 offered (first sale 2010-11-17), not the full size, so no accession is asserted.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XIII, LLC

sources.note: TechCrunch 2008-05-01: 'KPCB XIII, which will invest $700 million in greentech, information technology and life sciences ventures'. A paper Form D (2008-05-19), no machine-readable amount. Conflict: TechCrunch 2012-05-17 says 'its 13th fund's offering was sized at $950 million'; the 2008 announcement is published.

funds.name: KPCB Green Growth Fund, LLC

sources.note: TechCrunch 2008-05-01: 'a standalone $500 million Green Growth Fund'. The announced size; a paper Form D (2008-05-19).

funds.name: KPCB China Fund, L.P.

sources.note: SiliconANGLE 2011-11-03: 'Kleiner raised $360 million fund in its first round of investment conducted in year 2007' (decisions.md X1 also cites VentureBeat 2007-04-23). A paper Form D (2007-05-11). Reported by KPCB China Management, Ltd. (CRD 161470) and on Kleiner Perkins' 7.B.(2). Listed under the provisional reading of decisions.md X1.

funds.name: Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XII, LLC

sources.note: VentureBeat 2006-02-15: the firm 'has also finished raising its twelfth fund, at $600 million'; TechCrunch 2008-05-01: 'It raised $600 million for its twelfth fund just two years ago'. A paper Form D (2006-03-03).

individuals.name: Susan Biglieri
